gaps.description: The governing documents expire or may be superseded after 2026-09-30; OCF membership was prospective, not completed, in the reviewed current documents.
The latest located federal filing supports TNMC direct tax control of Bellevue for the period ended 2023-06-30, but current equity holders and percentages were not established.
The current registry schema permits only EIN and CCN identifiers, so NPI 1356307581 and NPI 1609007525 are preserved in entity notes and evidence rather than identifier arrays.

The current Nebraska DHHS roster reports 690 licensed beds for The Nebraska Medical Center while Nebraska Medicine's March 2026 consumer fast facts reports 718; the fixture makes no general bed-count claim.
This lean fixture does not claim an audited consolidated financial perimeter or an exhaustive subsidiary, clinic, and licensed-facility inventory.
